title: Conflict with other laws.
bodyText: All laws and parts of laws of this State inconsistent with this article are hereby superseded with respect to matters covered by this article.
bodyHtml: §431:11-116  Conflict with other laws.  All laws and parts of laws of this State inconsistent with this article are hereby superseded with respect to matters covered by this article. [L 1987, c 349, pt of §8]
